people.imagined: The high herb terrace at dawn. She has just rung the wooden bell for the children's weeding and is wiping soil from her hands onto her apron, the gourd at her hip smelling of every herb at once.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a high green terrace at dawn in a drift of mist, a small wooden bell hanging from one hand, the other palm brushed clean against her silk overskirt, looking out to the children weeding far below. Face: a square, sun-browned, solid face with strong cheekbones, wide-set kind dark eyes, thick straight brows, a broad nose, a firm warm mouth; weather lines at the eyes; about fifty. Hair: black with grey at the temples, dressed in a thick low knot held by a jade herb-leaf hairpin and a slim silver comb. Body: square, strong, short-waisted, shoulders broad, a planted, unhurried stance. Clothing: the head of the valley in its richest dress: three crossed collars of cream and herb-green silk embroidered with herbs and terrace lines in pale gold thread, a jade-green gauze over-robe whose wide sleeves are embroidered with every herb of the valley, sleeves turned back at the wrist, a cream silk overskirt, a green silk sash hung with jade pendants and a silk satchel of herbs. Hands and objects: faint soil still under her nails; a purple-brown gourd hung at the hip on a silk cord; a plain wooden bell held by its cord in the left hand. Power: a soft jade-green aura rests around her like new leaves, motes of green light drifting up from her hands. Background: dark green terraced slopes stepping down to a silver river, children tiny and blurred, mist between the terraces. Light: low gold dawn spirit-light from the upper left, a soft green rim light on her hair and shoulders. Expression: a warm, steady gaze with the corners of the mouth softly lifted, the look of someone who has all day to wait for a seed.

people.imagined: The stone furnace-house at night. He carries the small bronze censer with its live coal on a chain at his belt and has just heard that someone from Lăng Tiêu may still live. His hand freezes on the lid.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a furnace door at night, one burn-scarred hand frozen on a censer lid, glancing sharply at someone out of frame. Face: a gaunt, hollow-cheeked face with a hawk nose, deep-set dark eyes with a wary shine, heavy dark brows, a thin mouth drawn tight, a few white hairs in a scant beard; about fifty-five. Hair: black going grey, scraped back into a topknot with a bronze pin; a few strands have come loose and stick to the sweaty brow. Body: tall, thin, angular, shoulders high. Clothing: a guest-elder's robe of deep herb-green and cream silk in layered crossed collars embroidered with herbs and terrace lines, a dark brown gauze over-robe with sleeves rolled back from the forearms, a silk sash hung with a jade pendant; small scorch marks at the hems and cuffs. Hands and objects: both forearms covered with pale shiny burn scars, clearly visible; a small bronze censer on a chain at his belt, a live red coal glowing through its pierced lid; a pair of long iron tongs. The glow from the censer shows a ring of pierced stars on the underside of his jaw. Power: a strong warm red-orange aura of heat gathers at the coal, with sparks and glowing motes rising past his shoulders. Background: a dark stone furnace-house with a glowing red mouth, shimmering heat and drifting smoke, blurred. Light: red furnace spirit-light from the lower left on the face and forearms, an ember rim light along the jaw. Expression: eyes narrowed and flicking sideways, the jaw set and the mouth thin, a stillness held on purpose.

people.imagined: The landing at dusk, looking down the river toward Lạc Hà. She turns a burnt iron nail between her fingers on a string, her ferryman's hands hard and wiry, thinking of her brother.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a river landing at dusk, a bent, burnt iron nail on a string held up between thumb and finger, looking downriver with stubborn eyes. Face: a wiry, sharp, tanned face with high cheekbones, narrow dark eyes, thick straight brows, a straight nose, a hard mouth; a small scar on the chin; about thirty-seven. Hair: black, in a tight braid wrapped round the head and pinned with a plain silver pin, a light straw hat pushed back on a cord. Body: wiry, tough, lean-armed, a boatwoman's balance; weight on her back foot, shoulders square, arms loose. Clothing: a true disciple's robe of cream and herb-green silk, two crossed collars with a thin embroidered border of terrace lines, the wide sleeves tied back at the elbow with green cord, a cream silk overskirt hitched at one side and damp at the hem, a silk satchel holding a few dried herbs; barefoot on wet stone. Hands and objects: strong ferryman's hands, thick-palmed, clearly visible; the bent blackened old iron nail on a string, held up so the dusk makes it gleam dull red; a small gourd at the hip on a jade-bead cord. Power: a faint green wisp of qi curls round the gourd, nothing more. Background: a misty river landing with moored boats rocking, a burnt black post with a rope round it at the water's edge, far off a thin smoke over distant hills. Light: low orange dusk spirit-light from the left on the river, a soft glow on the water. Expression: a hard, level stare downriver, the jaw tight and the eyes bright with something not yet spilled.

people.imagined: A flooded rice terrace in the grey of the morning. The old field-warden leans both hands on a hoe he will not let anyone else carry, knee aching, and looks up, knowing the rain is coming before the sky does.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a flooded terrace field in the grey of morning, both hands crossed on the top of a long hoe handle, squinting up at the sky, one knee bent; he knows the rain is coming before the sky does. Face: a bent old man's brown, deeply creased face, a nose like a root, clouded kind eyes, thick white eyebrows, a toothless patient smile, a thin white beard; about seventy. Hair: white and wispy, gathered in a small knot with a jade herb-leaf hairpin, a wide straw hat shading the brow. Body: stooped, small, gnarled, leaning on the hoe, a bad knee. Clothing: an elder's jade-green gauze over-robe embroidered with herbs of the valley over cream and green silk collars, the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a cream silk overskirt mended at the hem and clean, a green sash with a single jade pendant; barefoot in the mud. Hands and objects: knotted hands crossed on a long-handled iron hoe worn smooth by his palms; a small silk pouch of seeds at the belt; one seed pinched between two fingers of the top hand. Power: a faint soft green and blue shimmer of Wood and Water in the air about him, like dew on young leaves, motes of pale light settling on the hoe. Background: green stepped terraces in silver morning mist, a few dark clouds gathering, blurred. Light: cool pearly spirit-light with no hard shadow, the wet terrace shining like pewter, a soft rim light on the hat. Expression: a toothless, easy smile with the eyes half shut against the sky, at peace with the weather.

people.imagined: The furnace-house at night, hot bronze smell, her singed eyebrows crooked. She is bent over a small pot of pill-ends she sweeps up, deciding which child will get them, a coin in her fist she never shows.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a hot furnace bench at night, sweeping pill-ends into a small bronze tray with a brush, glancing up with a measuring look. Face (most important: crooked singed eyebrows): a sharp, handsome, flushed face with sooty cheeks, narrow bright eyes, eyebrows singed uneven and grown back crooked, one higher than the other, a thin nose, a small clever mouth; about thirty-five. Hair: black, in a high topknot tied with a scrap of red silk and a bronze pin, soot in it; a smear of soot across the left temple. Body: slim, wiry, forward leaning, quick and neat in her hands. Clothing: a true disciple's robe of cream and herb-green silk with two crossed collars embroidered with herbs and terrace lines, a darker brown gauze over-robe with sleeves pushed up above the elbow, a silk sash with a small jade pendant; round burn holes at the cuffs and a scorched corner on the hem. Hands and objects: a brush sweeping round dark pills into the tray; the other hand closed round a coin held against her chest; a small bronze censer on the bench. Power: a faint red-orange glow of Fire flickers at her fingertips, sparks rising and fading. Background: the furnace mouth glowing behind her, a rack of bronze moulds on the wall, a bucket of water, wisps of smoke. Light: red furnace spirit-light from the lower left, orange heat shimmering in the air and lighting the edge of her ear. Expression: one crooked brow lifted, the eyes quick and measuring, a small shut smile that gives nothing away.

people.imagined: His office in Đào Thanh Thành as a price is named. He rubs a ginseng-root charm on a cord between finger and thumb and says the number; the contract on the desk has no one's name on it that he would meet.
people.subject: The moment: seated behind a lacquered desk, rubbing a small dried ginseng-root charm at his chest between finger and thumb as he names a price, with a smooth smile. Face: a plump, smooth, genial face with small cold eyes that do not smile, thin arched brows, a flat nose, a smiling mouth with fine teeth, a neat black moustache; about forty-five. Hair: black, oiled, in a high topknot with a jade pin, a small cap with a jade bead at the front. Body: round, comfortable, leaning back, well fed, fingers laced over his belly in lazy ease. Clothing: a fine robe of dark-green and brown silk in three crossed collars, the brown trim embroidered with linked circles in gold thread, a gauze over-robe of pale green with wide sleeves, a wide brocade sash hung with a jade pendant and tassels; richly neat and clean. Hands and objects: a small dried ginseng root shaped like a tiny man on a silk cord, held in the right hand; a stack of papers with red cord on the desk, marked only with ruled lines; a brass abacus; a plain gold ring on the left forefinger. Power: a faint ochre and green aura of Earth and Wood lies about him like warm haze. Background: a rich office with a latticed window onto a lamplit river port, barges and stacked crates, blurred. Light: warm lantern spirit-light from the upper left warming the papers and shining on his smooth cheek, a soft gold rim light. Expression: a pleasant, even smile that stops short of the cold eyes, the head tilted as if weighing a coin.

people.imagined: The path to the border, humming as she walks, her left hand curled round a packet of letters as if it were warm; she has read them, and decides to carry on.
people.subject: The moment: walking along a river path in warm afternoon haze, humming, her left hand curled round a small packet of letters held against her chest as if it were warm. Face: a young, open, friendly face with big dark eyes, arched brows, a small nose, a gentle smile slightly too ready; about twenty. Hair: black, in two braids with green ribbons, a small feathery fennel sprig tucked above the right ear, a straw hat on her back. Body: slim, light-stepping, easy, shoulders back and chin lifted, the left arm held close. Clothing: a junior disciple's graceful robe of cream and herb-green silk, two crossed collars with a thin border of herb embroidery, wide sleeves gathered at the wrist with green thread, a cream silk overskirt tucked up at one corner, a silk satchel at the hip; sturdy knotted sandals. Hands and objects: the left hand curled round a packet of folded letters tied with a string; the right swinging a small gourd on a jade-bead cord. Power: none beyond a faint green glint in the air above the gourd. Background: a river path under willows trailing green fronds into a slow river, a ferry at a far landing, a border hill pale in haze, drifting motes of light. Light: warm golden afternoon spirit-light from the upper left, the willows glowing yellow-green, a soft rim light on her braids. Expression: bright, open eyes and a gentle half-smile, the lips parted on a hummed note, hiding something.

people.imagined: Standing absolutely still among pine trunks on the terrace, so still that two sparrows have settled on his shoulders. His pitted grey face is the colour of pine fungus.
people.subject: The moment: standing perfectly motionless among dark pine trunks, a sparrow on each shoulder and one on his hat, so still the birds trust him. Face (most important: pitted grey face): a long, pale grey face pitted all over with small old pockmarks like the surface of a fungus, quiet round eyes, thin pale brows, a small nose, a closed patient mouth; about twenty-two. Hair: thin dark grey-brown, cropped short under a wide straw hat; a small grey feather rests above his ear. Body: tall, thin, stooped, arms hanging straight, feet together, the head tilted a little as he listens. Clothing: a junior disciple's simple pale-grey silk robe the colour of pine fungus, two crossed collars edged with cream and a thin green embroidered border of terrace lines, wide sleeves folded neatly to the elbow, a cream silk overskirt with a neat darn at the knee, a plain green sash; barefoot among pine needles. Hands and objects: a small hoe held loosely in the right hand; two small brown sparrows on his shoulders; a ball of grey pine fungus glowing faintly at his feet. Power: a faint soft green Wood glow lies about him, motes of pale green light drifting up like spores. Background: dark pine trunks and soft shade, mist weaving between them, a stack of mossy logs. Light: dappled green spirit-light from the upper left falling through the pines in a few pale shafts that rest on his shoulders. Expression: a smooth, empty face with wide quiet eyes, the mouth closed, listening to the birds.

people.imagined: The sick-house yard, a warden's broken arm in his hands. A wolf-tooth charm swings against forearms knotted from setting bones; he is impatient and gentle all at once.
people.subject: The moment: in a sick-house yard, setting a splint on a broken forearm held out to him, intent, a wolf-tooth charm swinging at his chest. Face: a lean, earnest, sunburnt young face with bold dark eyes, straight thick brows drawn in concentration, a firm jaw, a mouth set; about seventeen. Hair: black, short and bristling, a green silk band round the head. Body: wiry, a strong lean frame, leaning forward with shoulders hunched in effort and his back leg braced, chin down. Clothing: a junior disciple's short robe of cream and herb-green silk, two crossed collars stained faintly with old green juice, sleeves rolled to the elbow with mended at the elbow in matching silk, a cream silk overskirt knotted at the back, a silk strap holding a pouch of splint strips; straw sandals. Hands and objects: strong hands gripping a patient's splinted forearm, small old scars from fractures he has set himself; a large grey wolf tooth on a cord swinging at his chest, clearly visible; a roll of white bandage cloth at his belt. Power: a faint soft green Wood glow gathers along the bandage, a few pale motes. Background: a sick-house yard with bamboo racks of drying herbs, a stone water trough, a bench with splints laid out, mist and lantern glow, blurred. Light: bright clear spirit-light from the upper left giving every thread of the bandage a sharp edge, a soft rim light on his hair. Expression: brows drawn down, the jaw firm and the eyes fixed on the break, gentle hands and an impatient mouth.

people.imagined: A river market. He smiles slightly, pockets full of dried berries, before he names a price to two people who dislike each other; his own advantage already tucked away.
people.subject: The moment: at a river market stall at evening, he smiles slightly and lifts a small bag of berries, about to name a price. Face: a young, round, peaceable, smooth face with soft brown eyes, level brows, a small nose, a slight sly smile, a dimple; about nineteen. Hair: dark brown, in a neat topknot with a green silk cord. Body: slight, smooth, easy, weight on one leg, shoulders turned in a friendly, open angle. Clothing: an inner disciple's graceful robe of cream and herb-green silk, two crossed collars embroidered with herbs, wide sleeves rolled once at the wrist, a cream silk overskirt, a silk sash hung with many small pockets in different shades, each stitched with a different coloured thread and bulging with dried red berries; new sandals. Hands and objects: a small cloth bag of dried red schisandra berries held up; a few berries rolling on his palm; a silk satchel of pill packets wrapped in paper and tied with green string at his hip. Power: a faint soft green Wood shimmer round his hands, nothing more. Background: a row of stalls with striped awnings glowing with paper lanterns, baskets of dried roots, a long river crowded with small boats, blurred. Light: warm lantern spirit-light making the berries gleam like tiny red lamps, from the upper left, a soft rim light. Expression: a soft dimpled smile, the eyes mild and relaxed, one brow barely raised as he sets his price.

people.imagined: At the outer gate, lending pine nuts two for one, gold dust under her nails. She holds out a nut and looks at a hungry child with a shrewd little smile.
people.subject: The moment: at an outer gate she holds out a single pine nut between finger and thumb to a hungry child out of frame, with a shrewd little smile. Face: a bright, brown, freckled face with quick black eyes, arched brows, a snub nose, a sly little smile with a gap tooth; about sixteen. Hair: black, in two high bunches tied with green silk string. Body: small, sturdy, brisk; feet apart, free hand on her hip, chin up, the whole small frame set to bargain. Clothing: an outer disciple's simple graceful robe of cream silk with a green collar border embroidered with terrace lines, short wide sleeves, a cream silk overskirt with two large pockets stuffed with pine nuts, a string of dried red seeds round her neck. Hands and objects: fingers with glinting gold flecks under the nails, plainly visible; a small cloth bag of pine nuts drawn tight with a twisted grass cord in the left hand; one pine nut in the right. Power: none, only a faint blue Water gleam on the nut. Background: a wide rough gate of unplaned timber hung with a paper lantern, small children's faces peeking from behind a post, a bare courtyard in mist. Light: bright soft spirit-light from the upper left showing the gold flecks glittering under her nails, a gentle rim light on her bunches. Expression: a gap-toothed little smile, one eye narrowed as she sizes up the child, chin high.

people.imagined: The year she walked into the valley in 480 singing the old song of the four hermits: a woman of sixty with a straw hat and a seedling vine in a basket, laughing, at the edge of a green river plain.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, softly faded like old silk. A woman stands at the edge of a green river valley at the start of the world, a basket of seedlings on her arm, singing the old song of the four hermits. Face: a lean, sunburnt, generous face with deep laugh lines, bright dark eyes, a wide mouth open mid-song, thick grey brows; about sixty. Hair: grey, in a loose knot held by a single jade hairpin, a wide straw hat tied with a pale green ribbon. Body: strong, thin, upright, a long walker's stride, free arm swinging, head thrown back as she sings. Clothing: the first of the house, dressed as a wandering immortal in simple flowing robes of undyed cream silk gauze with two soft crossed collars, a long pale-green over-robe with wide sleeves rolled back and a hem darkened by river mud, a plaited silk-grass sash hung with a small dried gourd and a coil of cord; bare feet. Hands and objects: a flat basket on the left arm holding small green seedlings tied in bundles with grass and a young gourd vine; in the right hand a small curved picking-knife with a bone handle; a purple mushroom on a string at her belt. Power: a faint soft green shimmer of Wood about the seedlings, a few motes of green light drifting up from the basket. Background: a river plain of green mountains and a small hut at dawn, three more figures with baskets and hats walking in single file into the valley, mist on the peaks. Light: soft gold spirit-light from the upper left lying low across the plain, a gentle rim light on her hat. Expression: a wide-open mouth in song, laugh lines deep, the eyes warm and far away.

people.imagined: A flooded roof in 924, a herb-picker rowing up to a roof with a four-year-old crouching on it, lifting her gently into his herb basket and speaking softly.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, softly faded like old silk. An old herb-picker kneels in the stern of a boat in a flood and lifts a small child gently into a big herb basket on his back. Face: a lean, calm, kind weathered face with a long nose, deep eyes full of calm, long white brows, a thin white beard, a faint smile; about seventy. Hair: white, tied in a small knot with a jade herb-leaf hairpin under a wide straw hat. Body: tall, thin, upright, strong arms; one knee on a plank, back bent, long arms reaching out with great care. Clothing: the last head of the house in its richest dress, soaked: three crossed collars of cream and herb-green silk embroidered with herbs and terrace lines, a jade-green gauze over-robe clinging to his shoulders, a straw rain cape of overlapping bundles of rice-straw over it, dripping, trouser legs rolled to the knee. Hands and objects: both hands holding the small child (only a small hand and head visible) into a large round woven herb basket lined with green leaves; a long wooden pole in the boat. Power: a soft pale-green glow of Wood about the basket, a few drifting motes of light like fireflies in the rain. Background: grey flood water, a half-drowned tiled roof, floating branches and broken baskets, rain stippling the surface, mist. Light: a weak pearl spirit-light from the cloud giving no hard shadow, a faint green rim light on the cape. Expression: a quiet, tender look and a faint smile, the long white brows relaxed above steady eyes.

people.imagined: The doorway of the sick-house at night. Forty years of poultice have turned his sleeves yellow to the elbow; he looks at the torn hands of a dike child with stubborn tenderness.
people.subject: The moment: at the sick-house door at night he holds up a child's grazed, bandaged hand to the lamplight, frowning with tenderness. Face: a broad, tired, kind face with deep-set grey eyes, thick grey brows, a heavy nose, a gentle stubborn mouth, a short grey beard; about fifty-five. Hair: grey, cropped short, bareheaded. Body: broad, sturdy, a little stooped, leaning slightly left to favour a stiff hip, head bent over the small hand, shoulders heavy. Clothing: a true disciple's robe of cream and herb-green silk, crossed collars embroidered with herbs and terrace lines, wide sleeves turned back and stained yellow to the elbow by forty years of poultices, a cream silk overskirt clean and hemmed, a green sash hung with a jade pendant, a string of pale beads at his wrist holding a small knife for cutting bandages. Hands and objects: both forearms visibly yellowed to the elbow, fingertips stained pale green; a bowl of green paste and a neat roll of white cloth beside it. Power: a soft green Wood glow rests in the bowl of paste, a few pale motes lifting from it. Background: behind him a long row of cots each with a grey blanket and a still shape, folded white cloths on a shelf, a paper window with moonlight. Light: a warm lamp pool round his hands, the rest of the hall in grey-blue moonlight, a soft rim light on his beard. Expression: tired eyes soft above a firmly set mouth, brows drawn together over the small hand.

people.imagined: Dozing in the shade of the lingzhi beds, she tells the mushrooms the news in a murmur, straw sandals mended with three kinds of twine, content to let someone else do the weeding.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a low stool in the shade of the lingzhi beds, half asleep, murmuring the news to a red-brown mushroom beside her. Face: a soft, lazy, round face with half-closed contented eyes, a button nose, a gentle mouth, a sleepy smile; about forty. Hair: black, in a loose braid under a straw hat, a jade herb-leaf pin slipping loose. Body: comfortable, round, loose; slumped with her back against a mossy post and her feet stretched out, one hand on her stomach, the ease of a person with nowhere to be. Clothing: a true disciple's robe of cream and herb-green silk, crossed collars embroidered with herbs, wide sleeves rolled once, a cream silk overskirt with a long smudge of red mushroom spore down the front, a green sash; straw sandals mended with three kinds of twine, one yellow, one brown, one green. Hands and objects: one hand resting lightly on the cap of a glossy red-brown lingzhi mushroom the size of a plate; in the other a small tally cord with a dozen knots trailing to the ground. Power: a faint soft green Wood glow round the mushroom, spore-motes drifting up in the shade. Background: dim, green terraced beds under hemp shade cloth strung on poles, ranks of glossy red-brown mushrooms rising from dark soil, mist. Light: soft green-filtered spirit-light from the upper left, cool and clear, the mushrooms shining like lacquer, a pale rim light on her hat. Expression: eyes half closed, a slow sleepy smile, the cheeks relaxed as she murmurs.

people.imagined: Weeding the lingzhi terrace, chewing mint, the corner of her mouth green; she chatters to the mushrooms and makes up the news as she goes.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling between rows of lingzhi, weeding with a small hoe, chewing a mint leaf, mid-chatter. Face (most important: green-stained mouth corner): a bright, round, restless face with a wide mouth in mid-talk, the left corner stained green, quick brown eyes, thin arched brows, a freckled nose; about seventeen. Hair: dark brown, in a loose braid with a sprig of mint, a straw hat hanging on her back. Body: small, fidgety, sturdy; kneeling on one knee, leaning on the hoe with her free hand on her hip, a quick fidget in the shoulders. Clothing: an outer disciple's simple graceful robe of cream silk with a green collar border embroidered with herbs, short wide sleeves, a cream silk overskirt with a front pocket stuffed with fresh mint stems, the knees stained green and brown; barefoot. Hands and objects: a small hoe in one hand and a bunch of weeds in the other; a mint leaf between her teeth; a basket half full of weeds and mint beside her, a small hand-scythe on the ground. Power: none, only a few green motes of light round the mint. Background: neat rows of red-brown mushrooms under hemp shade cloth on a long terrace step, a larger terrace above with a pale thread of stream, soft mist. Light: soft dappled green spirit-light from the upper left across her face and the mushroom caps, a gentle rim light on her braid. Expression: the mouth open mid-chatter, bright restless eyes, a green-stained grin.

people.imagined: The sick-house bed, a wound under his hands. He looks up at the ceiling beam while his hands work, because he has learned that looking away steadies them.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a patient's arm, washing a wound, his face turned up toward the ceiling beams because looking away steadies his hands. Face: a quiet, calm, thin young face with a long nose, soft dark eyes turned upward, mild brows, a small neutral mouth; about twenty. Hair: black, short, neat, bound in a white silk head-cloth. Body: slim, steady, calm, narrow shoulders level, elbows close, the head tipped back at an odd angle while the hands work steadily below. Clothing: an inner disciple's graceful robe of cream and herb-green silk, crossed collars embroidered with herbs, wide sleeves rolled with great exactness, each fold the same width and damp at the cuffs, a cream silk overskirt with a small knot of grey thread at the pocket, a green sash. Hands and objects: both hands holding a bandaged forearm (the patient only a forearm in frame), cleaning it with a wet cloth from a small bowl of clear water with a pale green leaf floating in it; a roll of white cloth ready beside it; a small gourd at his belt. Power: a faint pale-green glow of Wood rises from the water, a few motes of light. Background: a low wooden sick-house with beams, bundles of dried herbs along the wall, a row of earthen jars, a hanging gourd, a hanging lamp. Light: steady yellow lamp spirit-light from the upper left leaving the ceiling in soft shadow, a faint rim light on his white head-cloth. Expression: a calm, gentle face tipped up, the eyes on the beams and the mouth quiet, unhurried.

people.imagined: The trade office, mouthing sums under his breath, an abacus bead clicking against his teeth; he is calculating what the mistress gives away for nothing.
people.subject: The moment: at a trade-office desk, clicking an abacus bead against his teeth while mouthing sums, eyes bright, calculating what the mistress gives away for nothing. Face: a young, sharp, quick, round face with bright black eyes, thin brows lifted, a snub nose, a mouth mouthing numbers with a bead between the teeth; about eighteen. Hair: black, in a neat topknot under a small cap of black silk. Body: slight, eager, hunched over the desk; sitting forward on the edge of his stool, knees together, elbows on the desk, bent toward the abacus like a bird at a seed. Clothing: an outer disciple's simple graceful robe of dark herb-green silk with a high collar edged in cream, a thin embroidered border of terrace lines, cuffs inked in a neat line, a cream silk overskirt, a pocket holding a brass pencil case. Hands and objects: a spare wooden abacus bead held at his teeth; the other hand on a full brass abacus; a pill packet on the desk and a neat stack of price slips at his elbow, each marked with a different small painted dot. Power: none. Background: shelves behind him of jars sealed with red wax, a bundle of paper tied in string, a map of the river drawn in black lines, a paper lantern glowing. Light: bright window spirit-light from the upper left catching the polished brass beads, a soft rim light on his cap. Expression: bright wide eyes and a bead clenched between the teeth, brows lifted in hungry delight.

people.imagined: Pausing at a landing, resting a hand on the rail, a net-knot tied round her smallest finger to remember her father's new net; she is asking again, quietly, to be put on the list.
people.subject: The moment: pausing at a river landing, one hand resting on the rail, looking steadily at someone off-frame as she asks again, quietly, to be put on the list. Face: a plain, honest, patient face with steady brown eyes, level brows, a straight nose, a small closed mouth; about twenty-one. Hair: black, in a single braid pinned up under a straw hat. Body: slim, upright, strong; feet together, her back very straight, shoulders drawn back, as though ready to carry a weight. Clothing: an inner disciple's graceful robe of cream and herb-green silk, crossed collars with a plain stitched hem, wide sleeves rolled once, a cream silk overskirt, a knotted cord of grey cotton at the waist; bare feet. Hands and objects: a small net-knot of cord tied round the left little finger, clearly visible; the left hand on a wooden rail; a bundle of herb stalks tied with blue thread in the right; a coil of fishing line at her belt. Power: none, only a faint blue Water glint on the river behind her. Background: a broad silver river, a row of drying nets between two poles, boats on the shingle with oars stacked, evening mist. Light: soft pearly spirit-light from the upper left off the river brightening her plain face, a gentle rim light on her hat. Expression: a steady direct gaze, level brows and a small closed mouth, patient and unashamed of asking.

people.imagined: Weeding beside the road, her eyes on the road and not on the person speaking to her; the packs may be back. A wolf-bane sprig is in her belt.
people.subject: The moment: standing among weeds with a hoe, looking down the road instead of at the person speaking to her; the packs may be back. Face: a thin, hard young face with watchful dark eyes, thick straight brows, a sharp nose, a tight mouth; a fine scar on one cheek; about sixteen. Hair: black, in a short rough braid under a straw hat. Body: thin, wiry, tense; feet planted, shoulders hunched, head turned toward the road, hoe held like a spear. Clothing: an outer disciple's simple graceful robe of cream silk with a green panel at the shoulder and a green collar border embroidered with terrace lines, wide sleeves rolled, a cream silk overskirt smudged at the edge from kneeling, a stitched leather band at the left wrist. Hands and objects: a hoe held ready in both hands; a sprig of purple wolf-bane with a few drooping hooded bells stuck in her belt; a small yellow wolf-tooth charm on a cord. Power: none. Background: a pale dusty road disappearing into a black pine wood, a broken fence post beside it, on the horizon a thin line of rain, cold mist. Light: cold grey spirit-light from the upper left giving the road a hard flat sheen, a thin pale rim light on her cheek. Expression: narrowed watchful eyes fixed on the far road, the mouth a tight line, the jaw hard.
